description: This file defines the interface for the AOTIModelPackageLoader class, which manages loading, running, and updating machine learning model packages in the torch::inductor namespace. It includes methods for retrieving model metadata, executing models with tensors, and handling constants.

classes.name: AOTIModelPackageLoader
classes.description: A class responsible for loading and managing machine learning model packages, executing models, and handling model constants.

methods.name: AOTIModelPackageLoader
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the loader with model package path, model name, threading options, and device index.

methods.name: get_metadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata associated with the loaded model package.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the model with input tensors and an optional stream handle.

methods.name: boxed_run
methods.description: Runs the model with ownership of input tensors transferred, and an optional stream handle.

methods.name: get_call_spec
methods.description: Returns a list of call specifications for the model.

methods.name: load_constants
methods.description: Loads constants into the model from a provided map, with options for inactive and full updates, and user management.

methods.name: get_constant_fqns
methods.description: Returns fully qualified names of constants.

methods.name: update_constant_buffer
methods.description: Updates the constant buffer with a given tensor map and options for validation and activity.

methods.name: load_metadata_from_package
methods.description: Static method to load metadata directly from a model package given its path and name.

methods.name: load_metadata
methods.description: Private method to load metadata from a specified C++ filename.
